transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 604 Concord Grove?
Yes, this is 604 Concord Grove. I’m safe, with three people here, and no water inside.
Thank you for confirming your safety and location. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
There are three people here total, and no one is unable to come to the phone.

Thank you for sharing that information with us. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one here can’t leave on their own. I just want to clarify — there’s no wheelchair or anyone bedbound.
Got it, no one here can’t leave on their own. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside the home right now. Just three people here, all able to leave on their own.
Thank you for the update. Stay alert and prepared. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No, I don’t have a high-clearance truck, boat, or any free seats in a vehicle to help neighbors. (I meant to say “I don’t have any vehicles available to help.”)
Thanks for sharing your situation honestly. Let me read that back: 3 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes, that’s right — three people, no water inside yet. Just to clarify, we’re all safe and able to help each other.
Thanks for confirming — you’re all okay and helping each other. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
